parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. If the number of results exceeds the page size, you can use the token that is returned for the previous request to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The IDs of gateways. You can query the tags of N gateways at a time.

> - You must specify at least one of ResourceId and Tag.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource region.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. The value must be GATEWAY.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description:
The tags.

> - You must specify at least one of ResourceId and Tag.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key. You can query N tag keys at a time. N can be an integer from 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

> You must specify at least one of ResourceId.N and Tag.N.Key.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the tag key. You can query N tag values at a time. N can be an integer from 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.
